examples.label: 사람 대기 (idle · 무표정)
examples.author: Pexels contributor
examples.notes: single person, static camera, plain grey background; man standing still, front-facing, framed head to thighs, arms down with both hands in frame, mouth closed, natural blink. Loop cut: source frames 492-642 (151 frames at 30 fps). Measured on the normalized clip: last->first frame has no global shift, mean |diff| 1.0/255, 0.16 % of pixels differ by > 20 (hair, hands), so it loops near-seamlessly. Real 720x1366 portrait, ~26s source. Frames verified.
